shots.prompt: Original creature design for our own game (not from any film): a small feathered jungle raptor with a moss-green and ochre body, a short crest of rust-orange feathers on the head and arms, a pale cream belly, dark speckles (no stripes), a stubby snout and big yellow eyes. Same elevated three-quarter camera from above and the same running pose as the first reference image; painterly semi-realistic style like the second reference. Soft overhead light from top-left, muted colours for a dark jungle floor. Plain flat pure white background, no ground, no shadow, no text.
